description: This file defines a mock maps service for geocoding, routing, and tile mode switching, including sample POIs, mock route calculations, and related methods.

methods.name: getSamplePOIs
methods.description: Returns the list of sample points of interest (POIs).

methods.name: geocode
methods.description: Mock geocoding: filters sample POIs by name substring match.

methods.name: reverseGeocode
methods.description: Mock reverse geocode: finds nearest POI based on coordinate proximity.

methods.name: planRoute
methods.description: Creates a mock route with polyline, steps, and summary info between origin and destination.

methods.name: switchTileMode
methods.description: Stub for switching tile mode, validating input mode.
